S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: A persistent perception that one is useless or inferior to others.
subtypes.Self-Criticism: Excessively and repeatedly blaming oneself for past minor failures or flaws.
subtypes.Reduced Self-Efficacy: Distrust in one's own ability to perform tasks or solve problems.
subtypes.Chronic Sense of Inferiority: Persistently evaluating oneself lower in comparison to others.
subtypes.Lack of Self-Assurance: Continually feeling anxious and unsure about decisions or actions.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major changes in working hours or conditions
patient_info.stressor: When Juancarlos’s cleaning contractor took over several larger properties in Leander, his predictable daytime routine changed to rotating evening and overnight shifts with tighter inspection standards and less control over the eco-friendly supplies he preferred. At first he treated the change like another checklist problem, but over the next three years his low mood became a constant backdrop, his sleep never fully adjusted, and he began losing focus on inventory logs and certification study plans. As his stalled supervisory goals fed a steady sense that he was not capable enough, his work remained reliable but slower, and he withdrew from some neighborhood clean-ups and family gatherings. He eventually mentioned the three-year pattern during a primary care visit for fatigue, and the physician referred him for psychiatric evaluation.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: Most days I feel like there’s this heavy, flat feeling following me around, even when I’m just pushing the cart down an empty hallway or sitting with my family and trying to act normal.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: My sleep has been messed up for a long time now, where after an overnight shift I’ll lie there tired but wired, and even when I do sleep a decent number of hours I wake up feeling like I barely rested.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.
S031.manifestation: I came in because my head just doesn’t stay on task anymore, like I’ll be doing inventory or studying for the supervisor certification and I keep reading the same line or forgetting what I went to the supply closet for.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.
S042.manifestation: I keep telling myself other guys would have adjusted by now and moved up, but I’m still just trying not to miss small things at work, so it makes me feel like maybe I’m not cut out for more than this.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I still get the cleaning done, but I’m slower and second-guess my logs so much that I’ve stopped pushing for the supervisor track and I’ve been skipping neighborhood clean-ups and family get-togethers I used to make time for.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about three years, since the contractor changed us to rotating evening and overnight shifts at the larger properties.
